name: MLPS Review
tagline: Manage MLPS projects, knowledge bases, and document review records.
description: MLPS Review helps teams manage companies, MLPS projects, company knowledge bases, and document review records. The app extracts PDF, DOCX, TXT, and Markdown text with a bundled Executa, retrieves relevant company knowledge, and asks the host LLM for compliance gaps, evidence, and remediation suggestions.
